title: Effects of Sulforaphane on SARS‑CoV‑2 infection and NF‑kappaB dependent expression of genes involved in the COVID‑19 'cytokine storm'.
authors: Gasparello, Jessica; Marzaro, Giovanni; Papi, Chiara; Gentili, Valentina; Rizzo, Roberta; Zurlo, Matteo; Scapoli, Chiara; Finotti, Alessia; Gambari, Roberto
one_liner_zh: 该文用Martini粗粒化MD模拟研究SFN与NF-kB及DNA三元复合物的结合，揭示其干扰NF-kB-DNA互作并抑制炎症基因表达，属广义蛋白-DNA互作机制研究，方法可迁移至TF-DNA体系。
abstract: Since its spread at the beginning of 2020, the coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID‑19) pandemic represents one of the major health problems. Despite the approval, testing, and worldwide distribution of anti‑severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS‑CoV‑2) vaccines, the development of specific antiviral agents targeting the SARS‑CoV‑2 life cycle with high efficiency, and/or interfering with the associated 'cytokine storm', is highly required. A recent study, conducted by the authors' group indicated that sulforaphane (SFN) inhibits the expression of IL‑6 and IL‑8 genes induced by the treatment of IB3‑1 bronchial cells with a recombinant spike protein of SARS‑CoV‑2. In the present study, the ability of SFN to inhibit SARS‑CoV‑2 replication and the expression of pro‑inflammatory genes encoding proteins of the COVID‑19 'cytokine storm' was evaluated. SARS‑CoV‑2 replication was assessed in bronchial epithelial Calu‑3 cells. Moreover, SARS‑CoV‑2 replication and expression of pro‑inflammatory genes was evaluated by reverse transcription quantitative droplet digital PCR. The effects on the expression levels of NF‑kappaB were assessed by western blotting. Molecular dynamics simulations of NF‑kB/SFN interactions were conducted with Gromacs 2021.1 software under the Martini 2 CG force field. Computational studies indicated that i) SFN was stably bound with the NF‑kappaB monomer; ii) a ternary NF‑kB/SFN/DNA complex was formed; iii) the SFN interacted with both the protein and the nucleic acid molecules modifying the binding mode of the latter, and impairing the full interaction between the NF‑kappaB protein and the DNA molecule. This finally stabilized the inactive complex. Molecular studies demonstrated that SFN i) inhibits the SARS‑CoV‑2 replication in infected Calu‑3 cells, decreasing the production of the N‑protein coding RNA sequences, ii) decreased NF‑kappaB content in SARS‑CoV‑2 infected cells and inhibited the expression of NF‑kB‑dependent IL‑1beta and IL‑8 gene expression. The data obtained in the present study demonstrated inhibitory effects of SFN on the SARS‑CoV‑2 life cycle and on the expression levels of the pro‑inflammatory genes, sustaining the possible use of SFN in the management of patients with COVID‑19.
abstract_zh: 自2020年初传播以来，2019冠状病毒病（COVID-19）大流行已成为重大健康问题之一。尽管抗严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2（SARS-CoV-2）疫苗已获批准、测试并在全球范围内分发，但仍亟需开发针对SARS-CoV-2生命周期具有高效性、和/或干扰相关“细胞因子风暴”的特异性抗病毒药物。作者团队近期开展的一项研究表明，莱菔硫烷（SFN）可抑制IB3-1支气管细胞经SARS-CoV-2重组刺突蛋白处理后诱导的IL-6和IL-8基因表达。在本研究中，评估了SFN抑制SARS-CoV-2复制及编码COVID-19“细胞因子风暴”蛋白的促炎基因表达的能力。在支气管上皮Calu-3细胞中评估了SARS-CoV-2复制。此外，通过逆转录定量微滴数字PCR评估了SARS-CoV-2复制及促炎基因表达。通过蛋白质印迹法评估了对NF-kappaB表达水平的影响。使用Gromacs 2021.1软件在Martini 2 CG力场下进行了NF-kB/SFN相互作用的分子动力学模拟。计算研究表明：i) SFN与NF-kappaB单体稳定结合；ii) 形成了三元NF-kB/SFN/DNA复合物；iii) SFN与蛋白质和核酸分子均发生相互作用，改变了后者的结合模式，并削弱了NF-kappaB蛋白与DNA分子之间的完全相互作用。这最终稳定了非活性复合物。分子研究表明，SFN i) 抑制感染Calu-3细胞中的SARS-CoV-2复制，减少N蛋白编码RNA序列的产生，ii) 降低SARS-CoV-2感染细胞中的NF-kappaB含量，并抑制NF-kB依赖性IL-1beta和IL-8基因表达。本研究获得的数据表明，SFN对SARS-CoV-2生命周期及促炎基因表达水平具有抑制作用，支持SFN在COVID-19患者管理中可能的应用价值。
